executive_profile.name: Dr. Zaid Amin
executive_profile.institution: Faculty of Data Science and Information Technology (FDSIT), INTI International University, Malaysia
executive_profile.distinction: Ph.D. in Computer Science (UKM) • Tesis Cemerlang (Excellent Thesis) & Graduate on Time (GOT)
executive_profile.summary: Accomplished Senior Lecturer and Researcher holding a Ph.D. from Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM), recognized with the 'Tesis Cemerlang' and Graduate on Time (GOT) distinction, with a proven track record of heading university informatics departments. A globally recognized scholar and active Q1 journal reviewer (IEEE Access, PLOS ONE, Computers in Human Behavior). Recipient of the prestigious Global Panduit-Cisco Excellence Scholarship and an accomplished book author. Research at the intersection of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), philosophy, and digital ethics focuses on the engineering of trustworthy multimodal AI architectures to drive positive behavioral change.
